title: Economic Policy Uncertainty Index for Poland: Data, Construction, and Validation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05640v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We construct a continuous monthly Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) index for Poland spanning January 2000 to June 2026, following the newspaper-based Baker-Bloom-Davis (BBD) methodology. The index uses six deep-history Polish newspapers (Rzeczpospolita, Parkiet, Gazeta Wyborcza, Dziennik Gazeta Prawna, Gazeta Polska Codziennie, and Puls Biznesu), scaled by article volume, standardized to unit standard deviation over a fixed 2000-2024 baseline (300 months), averaged across available papers each period, and normalized so the baseline mean equals 100.   Because newspapers enter the panel at different dates, a naive expanding-panel average can jump at each entry point from a change in composition rather than real uncertainty. We correct for this using the BBD Appendix A splicing procedure: a backward chain-splice from the richest six-paper anchor panel that matches dispersion via a multiplicative scale factor and matches level via a multipl

translated_title: 波兰经济政策不确定性指数：数据、构建与验证
translated_abstract: 我们遵循基于报纸文本的Baker-Bloom-Davis（BBD）方法，构建了覆盖2000年1月至2026年6月、连续的波兰月度经济政策不确定性（EPU）指数。该指数基于六份拥有深厚历史的波兰报纸（Rzeczpospolita、Parkiet、Gazeta Wyborcza、Dziennik Gazeta Prawna、Gazeta Polska Codziennie 和 Puls Biznesu），按文章总量进行缩放，在固定的2000-2024年基线期（300个月）上标准化为单位标准差，每期对所有可用报纸的结果取平均，并进行归一化使基线期均值等于100。由于各报纸在不同时点加入样本面板，朴素的扩展面板平均方法可能在每个报纸加入时点因样本构成变化（而非真实的不确定性变化）而产生指数跳变。我们采用BBD附录A中的拼接程序对此加以修正：从覆盖最全的六报锚定面板出发进行向后链式拼接，通过乘法比例因子匹配离散度、通过乘法因子匹配水平。
tldr: 本文基于BBD报纸文本方法构建了波兰2000-2026年的月度经济政策不确定性指数，并利用链式拼接修正程序解决了报纸面板构成变化导致的指数跳变问题。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a monthly Economic Policy Uncertainty index for Poland spanning 2000-2026 using the newspaper-based BBD methodology, employing a chain-splicing procedure to correct for index jumps caused by changes in newspaper panel composition.
